bugs.error_message: NG0500: During hydration Angular expected a text node but the node was not found in <textarea> inside ContactComponent. Mat-icons also rendered as plain text strings.
bugs.root_cause: Textarea had whitespace (newline + spaces) between its opening and closing tags. SSR prerender creates a text node for this whitespace, but Angular hydration on the client doesn't expect it — mismatch causes NG0500 and cascading re-render that breaks mat-icon ligature rendering.
bugs.fix: Collapsed textarea to a single line: changed `placeholder='...'>\n                </textarea>` to `placeholder='...'></textarea>` (no whitespace between tags).

bugs_continued.error_message: Mobile view shows padding on left but not right on contact page and potentially other pages
bugs_continued.root_cause: CSS Grid children default to min-width: auto. The .contact-info and .contact-form-container grid children of .contact-content could grow wider than their grid cell, pushing past the container's padding. Also, .form-row breakpoint was 560px (too narrow) — at 560-768px it stayed 2-column but the parent was already single-column, creating cramped fields that looked like no right padding.
bugs_continued.fix: 1) Added min-width: 0 to .contact-info and .contact-form-container in contact.component.scss. 2) Changed .form-row breakpoint from max-width:560px to max-width:768px. 3) Applied same min-width:0 and 560px→768px fixes to about and fleet components. 4) Added overflow-x: hidden to body in styles.scss as safety net.
